name: SameRow Connect
description: Connect your Jellyfin server directly to SameRow for watch parties without port forwarding.
overview: Watch movies and shows together in real time on SameRow. Connect through the Jellyfin plugin without port forwarding.

versions.changelog: Keep relay connection status stable when individual workers hit rate limits or a viewer cancels a request.
Enable the home WebRTC sender by default after pairing. HTTPS relay fallback remains available.
Fix Jellyfin 12.3 dashboard authentication for status, pairing, and plugin settings requests.
